# Edison Dental 27

> Family-owned dental practice in Edison, NJ. Four dentists and an in-house
> dental lab providing preventive, restorative, cosmetic, and specialty care.
> Dr. Yan Ma has cared for Edison families for two decades.

## Contact
- Phone: (732) 555-0127
- Location: Edison, NJ (08817)
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–6pm
- Emergency: Same-day care for pain, trauma, and infection.

## Services
- Preventive & Family Care: Cleanings & Hygiene, New Patient Exam, Gum Disease Treatment, Children's Dentistry
- Restorative Dentistry: Fillings, Crowns & Bridges, Root Canals, Dental Implants, Dentures
- Cosmetic & Orthodontics: Veneers, Teeth Whitening, Invisalign, Traditional Braces, Smile Makeovers
- Specialty & Advanced: Wisdom Teeth & Extractions, TMJ & Night Guards, Sleep Apnea, Full-Mouth Reconstruction

## Insurance & Financing
- In-network with Delta Dental; fee-for-service for other plans.
- Out-of-network PPO claims filed for you. Cherry financing available.
